name: Crownshadow Arcade
introDiscord:
A covered shopping arcade winds beneath the palace.

Old boutiques, cafés, jewelry stalls, and tailoring shops sit beneath
shadowed arches.

Shizuki clearly had the time of her life.
introTwitch:
A covered shopping arcade winds beneath the palace.

Old boutiques, cafés, jewelry stalls, and tailoring shops sit beneath
shadowed arches.

Shizuki clearly had the time of her life.

crownshadow-arcade-approach.prompt: Crownshadow Arcade opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message: A jewelry stall contains Star Candies among imitation royal gems.

right.message: A café counter still contains restorative tea salts.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A Crownshadow Stalker emerges from behind a mannequin.

crownshadow-arcade-depths.prompt: Deeper within Crownshadow Arcade, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message: A Stalker moves between abandoned shops.

right.message:
One Berry rests beneath a handwritten storefront sign:

'SHIZUKI'S SECOND TOTALLY LEGITIMATE SHOP

Now selling:
one Berry
one shiny button
Glimmer not for sale.'

forward.message: A tailor's coffer contains Star Candies.

crownshadow-arcade-threshold.prompt: Near Shadowed Audience, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: A perfumer's lockbox contains Star Candies.

right.message: A Stalker blocks the route to Shadowed Audience.

forward.message:
Shizuki's bottle is labeled:

'Shopping recovery.

Critical resource.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

bossPromptDiscord:
The arcade lights dim.

At the far end, one shadowed chamberlain steps from an abandoned royal
boutique.

Use /yes to enter Shadowed Audience or /no to continue
window shopping.
bossPromptTwitch:
The arcade lights dim.

At the far end, one shadowed chamberlain steps from an abandoned royal
boutique.

Use !yes to enter Shadowed Audience or !no to continue
window shopping.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Shadowed Audience. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The Chamberlain retreats into shadow.

Shizuki's second shop remains bankrupt.
